result.final: Fixed wchunk to match the authoritative samples: real layout is header (WCHK, v2, u32-LE count, 3 reserved) + records of tag/size as u16-LE + payload, each record zero-padded to 8-byte alignment, followed by a 6-byte footer of zlib CRC-32 (u32 LE, over header+records incl. padding) plus u16-LE tag-sum. compute_crc is now standard zlib.crc32; unpack/verify/pack/iter_records/read_all all rewritten for this layout with correct WChunkError kinds (magic/version/truncated/structure/checksum), verify never raises, and iter_records stays lazy using only fixed-size read(n) and checks the footer (CRC + tag sum) after the last record. Both sample.wchk and sample_empty.wchk round-trip byte-identically.
